scope: Retrospective descriptive manuscript extension using preserved completed runs; not a new confirmatory experiment
research_questions: Does coupled log-density Newton improve discrete acceptance over legacy fixed relaxation under identical final boundary conditions?
Does discrete/current acceptance agree with predeclared field mesh acceptance?
How do explicit acceptance policies change the retained dataset, and are exported neutral fields analytically correct?

additional_neutral_field_check.description: Each neutral-case full array compared to independently derived constant concentration and linear potential, not just current
additional_neutral_field_check.rationale: Algebraically exact representable solution; threshold far above roundoff and below production field-accuracy criteria

policy_audit: Candidate discrete gate plus original scenario-level mesh field gate
Actual conservative dataset policy: neutral analytical case checks only
interpretation: Report deterministic finite-matrix selection counts and diagnostics, not causal workflow efficacy, universal correctness or domain-wide error bounds
